evaluation_notes: A/B/C are different time periods from one acquisition campaign, not independent sites or seasons.
Only source timestamps are repaired; measurement values and quality flags are not imputed, smoothed or rescaled again.
Source measurements were aligned by linear interpolation before this split; raw interpolation support across split boundaries is unavailable.
A frozen-model spatial evaluation must hide target sensors from the same-frame correction inputs.
Existing saved models were not trained under this split; retrain on A for the new experiment.
Role flags describe the experiment protocol; the current upload API does not enforce these flags.
